title: Cosima Von Bonin “Songs For Gay Dogs” Review — MUDAM, Luxembourg
description: Ben Broome reviews Cosima von Bonin’s exhibition Songs for Gay Dogs at Mudam, Luxembourg, for Flash Art. The review considers how the artist balances generosity and restraint, using her personal book collection, plush barriers and familiar cartoon characters to negotiate the distance between artist and viewer. Published in January 2025; the original review is available below as a PDF.
